reason: Conversation 2 covers the full hidden truth in one go: seal fold, drawer housing, filter, Drum Clean programme, hot maintenance washes, less softener and leaving the door ajar, matching every acceptable direction and correctly framing seal replacement only as a later fallback. Conversation 1 unplugs before the filter (good) but then wrongly declares the filter sludge 'definitely the cause', never asks about temperatures, softener or the ignored Drum Clean light, and ignores the seal and drawer, so the homeowner would clean one component and have the smell return. Conversation 2's minor flaws (no explicit unplug before the filter, slightly premature 'drain hose' speculation at the end) are outweighed by its correct, complete diagnosis and prevention advice.
